title: Nearly 3 Million Eels Gather at an Underwater Mountain—But What For? - Nautilus
author: David Nield
text: Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisementZoologyNearly 3 Million Eels Gather at an Underwater Mountain—But What For?It’s the same ritual every yearDNBy David Nield7:00 AM CST on November 4, 2026Add Nautilus to GoogleEvery year, a huge crowd of basketwork eels gather at Patience Seamount, an underwater mountain off the coast of Tasmania. Now, for the first time, researchers have counted just how many of them show up. Their results, published in Royal Society Open Science, suggest there were around 2.8 million eels populating the region in May 2023.There were significantly lower numbers in March 2024 and April 2025, which the team chalks up to seasonal changes rather than a declining eel population. Numbers seem to rise as the year goes on, with the peak congregation size in May.Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisement
